SELECT * FROM warehouse.stock_adjustments WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' ORDER BY adjusted_ts;

SELECT
  (SELECT sum(qty) FROM store.pos_lines WHERE sku_scanned='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') AS pos_units_june,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < '2026-07-01') AS audits,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='on shelf' AND audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < '2026-07-01') AS on_shelf,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM store.shelf_audits WHERE sku='ATTA-WW-5KG' AND status='empty' AND audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND audit_ts < '2026-07-01') AS empty;

SELECT count(DISTINCT l.bill_id) AS june_bills_lines,
       count(DISTINCT p.bill_id) AS june_bills_paid,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT bill_id FROM store.pos_lines WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01') l
         WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments.pos_payments p WHERE p.bill_id = l.bill_id)) AS june_bills_unpaid
FROM store.pos_lines l
LEFT JOIN payments.pos_payments p ON p.bill_id = l.bill_id
WHERE l.bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND l.bill_ts < '2026-07-01';

SELECT p.pick_ts, p.order_id, p.shipment_id, p.sku, p.slot, p.cases_ordered, p.cases_confirmed,
       p.cases_ordered - p.cases_confirmed AS short_cases

ORDER BY p.pick_ts;

WITH sd AS (
  SELECT d.date, f.forecast_units_per_day AS fc, p.price_inr
  FROM store.daily_sales d
  JOIN store.forecasts f ON f.sku = d.sku AND f.date = d.date
  JOIN store.products p ON p.sku = d.sku
  WHERE d.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND d.date >= '2026-06-01' AND d.date < '2026-07-01'
    AND d.units_sold = 0
),
b AS (
  SELECT bill_ts::date AS d,
         count(DISTINCT bill_id) AS bills,
         count(DISTINCT bill_id) FILTER (WHERE sku_scanned = 'ATTA-WW-5KG') AS bills_with_atta
  FROM store.pos_lines
  WHERE bill_ts >= '2026-06-01' AND bill_ts < '2026-07-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sd.date, sd.fc AS forecast_units, sd.price_inr, b.bills, b.bills_with_atta,
       (SELECT a.status FROM store.shelf_audits a
         WHERE a.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND a.audit_ts::date = sd.date) AS audit_status,
       (SELECT ib.book_on_hand_close FROM store.inventory_book ib
         WHERE ib.sku = 'ATTA-WW-5KG' AND ib.date = sd.date) AS book_close
FROM sd JOIN b ON b.d = sd.date
ORDER BY sd.date;
